TO ALL RESIDENTS AND QUALIFIED: NOTICE OF GENERAL ELECTION
TO ALL RESIDENTS AND QUALIFIED ELECTORS
OF MEADE COUNTY, KANSAS
In accordance with K.S.A. 25-105, please take notice that a General Election will be held on November 3, 2026. The following National, State, and County races will be submitted to the qualified electors of Meade County, Kansas.
The last day to register to vote is October 13, 2026, K.S.A. 25-2311(a)(3)
Advance voting in person will begin October 19, 2026, at the Meade County Clerk’s Office, 200 N. Fowler, Meade, KS 67864.

IN-PERSON ADVANCE VOTING
In-person advance voting for the General Election will begin October 19, 2026, through November 2nd, 2026, 8 am to 5 pm November 2nd 8 a.m. to noon. October 27 th is the last day to apply for an advance ballot by mail.
NOTICE OF PUBLIC TESTING
The public testing of vote-counting equipment to be used in the General Election of November 3, 2026, will be held at the County Courthouse, 200 N. Fowler, Meade, Kansas, on October 29, 2026, at 10:00 am
The General Election is Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Polls open at 7:00 a.m. and close at 7:00 p.m.
ORDER
For Closing of Registration Books
Before General Election
November 3, 2026
Pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 25-2311c, notice is hereby given that on the 13th day of October 2026, all voter registration books for the General Election will close at the end of regular business hours. Registration books will remain closed until the 4th day of November 2026.
WITNESS MY HAND and seal of my office this 5th day of October 2026.
Amber Holsted
Meade County Clerk

NOTICE OF BOND ELECTION
UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT NO. 476,
GRAY COUNTY, KANSAS (COPELAND)
The Board of Education of Unified School District No. 476, Gray County, Kansas (Copeland) (the “District”), has heretofore, pursuant to resolution duly adopted, declared it advisable to make and finance certain improvements to District facilities pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 10‑101 et seq ., K.S.A. 25‑2018(f), K.S.A. 72‑5457, and K.S.A. 72‑5458 et seq . Notice is hereby given to the qualified electors of the District that a bond election has been called and will be held on November 3, 2026, for the purpose of submitting to the qualified electors of the District the following proposition:
Shall the following be adopted?
Shall Unified School District No. 476, Gray County, Kansas (Copeland), issue general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $5,600,000, to pay the costs to construct, furnish and equip a new elementary school addition, and all necessary improvements related thereto; all pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 10‑101 et seq ., K.S.A. 25‑2018(f), K.S.A. 72‑5457, and K.S.A. 72‑5458 et seq .?
To vote in favor of any question submitted on this ballot, press the word “Yes” on the voting machine or completely darken the oval to the left of the word “Yes” on the paper ballot. To vote against it, press the word “No” on the voting machine or completely darken the oval to the left of the word “No” on the paper ballot.
YES
NO

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
The Capital Improvement Fund (“CIF”) has been established in the treasury of the State of Kansas to assist school districts with making principal and interest payments on voted general obligation bond issues. The amount of CIF funding each school district receives is based on a formula prescribed by statute and implemented by the State Board of Education (“Bond State Aid”). Based on the current formula, the District expects to receive Bond State Aid in the approximate amount set forth below to assist with making the principal and interest payments on the Bonds. No assurance can be given that Bond State Aid will continue at this or any amount in future years.

This information has been obtained from sources deemed reliable by the District. Certain portions of this information are based upon projections.
